name: Modbus Client
description: The `modbus_client` component provides actions for ad-hoc Modbus request/response exchanges from automations and lambdas, using an existing [Modbus](https://esphome.io/components/modbus/) hub in the client role.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The Modbus device address every call from this client targets. Unlike [Modbus Controller](https://esphome.io/components/modbus_controller/), there is no default.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The ID to use in lambdas. Unlike most components it is not generated for you: the device is only reachable through `id()`, so an entry without one is rejected.

config_entries.label: Modbus ID
config_entries.description: The Modbus hub to send on. Automatically assigned when a single hub is configured.
